title: Уязвимость ядра CVE-2026-98432
summary: use-after-free in the IPv4 TCP SYN path when the SYN carries IP options; network-reachable, Ubuntu priority high
stopgap_note: nft rule drops inbound IPv4 TCP with IP options (upstream-system ops/server, ipv4-options-drop.service); remove with: systemctl disable --now ipv4-options-drop.service
